transcript.text: hey whats up
not much, just got home from grabbing coffee. feeling a lil playful tonight 🖤
haha playful eh? just got off work myself, long day at the office. what kinda coffee u get?

black iced with oat milk, tryna be healthy

But lowkey wishing u were here to help with this playful mood 😏
haha ur such a flirt. black iced sounds good, im more of a hot latte guy. whats ur job like?
what do u even do in that office job anyway
im in marketing, like creating ads and campaigns for brands. its ok, kinda creative sometimes. what about u, got a day job?

getting to be creative like that. me? this fanvue thing is my full time now, quit bartending a bit ago

but ur makin me wanna skip it all and just chill with u

whats the coolest campaign uve done?
haha chillin sounds chill lol. coolest was a viral vid for a beer brand, got celebs involved. turned out huge. u miss bartending?

but not the late nights fr

lowkey fresh out the shower and still in just a towel tho

U'd be in trouble if u were here babe
haha damn, towel life. nah i bet bartending had some fun stories tho. whats the wildest thing that happened on shift?

wildest was this bachelorette party that turned into a full dance-off on the bar, drinks flying everywhere

But rn im more focused on this towel situation... u makin me wanna drop it
haha wild story, sounds chaotic fun. bet u got good tips that night. whats ur go-to drink to make?

old fashioned, cant go wrong with a classic

but u got me lowkey heated up here still in this towel... wish u were around to see

U drink beer a lot after those long marketing days babe?
haha damn, towel vibes. yeah i grab a beer sometimes to unwind, like an ipa. u make old fashioneds at home too?

when im tryna unwind fr

But u got me thinkin about droppin this towel instead... lowkey heated from our chat babe
haha damn, heated chat. yeah old fashioneds are solid for unwinding. whats ur fav way to relax after a long day?
Old fashioned and a thunderstorm watchin session, lowkey
haha thunderstorms sound relaxing, i love watchin em from my porch. any big storms where u are lately?
(no reply within 90s)
